subject: physical-education
essentialQuestion: How can understanding throwing, catching, striking, and kicking help us explain, decide, create, or solve something that matters?

prompts.prompt: Explain object tracking in your own words and give or identify a valid example.
Use a diagram, model, quotation, data display, map, demonstration, or worked process to show understanding of throwing accuracy.
Apply catching control in a new realistic situation. Show the process or cite evidence.
Analyze a plausible error, weak claim, unsafe choice, or design flaw involving striking with hand or implement; correct it and explain why.
Connect object tracking with skill combinations. Explain how the ideas support, constrain, contrast with, or build on one another.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit project: Complete a skill-challenge portfolio showing cue use and personal improvement.
Identify one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy or quality, and one next question.
